label: ex:bach-intensity-profile
title: Digitized Intensity Profile (Bach et al. 2013, Figure 3e)

meta.digitizationMethod: Threshold-based pixel extraction from arXiv PDF, 150-bin histogram

html:
The intensity profile was digitized from Figure 3e of [bach2013] (6235 electron detections, central five diffraction orders). The digitization was performed by threshold-based bright pixel extraction from the arXiv PDF (arXiv:1210.6243v1), producing a 150-bin histogram of horizontal electron positions mapped to scattering angle via the measured fringe spacing.

Experimental parameters: a = 50 nm, d = 280 nm, \lambda = 50 pm, E = 600 eV.

The digitized data spans \pm 2.56 mrad in scattering angle and shows five resolved interference maxima consistent with the double-slit geometry. The central peak is normalized to unity.

The standard Fraunhofer prediction for these parameters is

  I(\theta) = \cos^2\!\left(\frac{\pi\,d\sin\theta}{\lambda}\right)
  \cdot \mathrm{sinc}^2\!\left(\frac{\pi\,a\sin\theta}{\lambda}\right),

which predicts fringe spacing \Delta\theta = \lambda / d \approx 0.179 mrad.

The digitized profile is used in the double-slit simulator alongside the standard QM prediction and the QOU q-deformed model for direct three-way comparison.
